name: app-payment-receipt-card-over-street-photo
title: Frosted transaction card overlaid on a candid street purchase photo
whatItIs: A photograph of a barista handing a paper bag to a customer on a bustling street. A large white frosted card at the bottom shows a merchant logo, name, category, price and reference number.
whatItMeans: Human and contextual; the receipt card links the number to a real moment.
techniques: Overlay a translucent UI card on a lifestyle photo to connect data with life.
Use a clean row layout: logo, name and category left, amount right.
Choose a candid, sunlit street photo with depth.
Let the card partially cover the photo's lower area.

vocabulary.definition: A UI card placed over a photograph.
A list item showing logo, name and amount.
A photo that shows real use of a product.
